metrics.description: Nominal (statutory) paid-in share capital, from the equity section of the balance sheet. Tracked primarily as a change-detector for the share-count ledger (katman 6): a jump between periods signals a capital increase/decrease event requiring a new share-count-ledger record, derived as paid_in_capital / nominal_value_per_share (see formula share_count.nominal_to_quote_units.v1, already used in the EREGL ledger). Not itself a share count.

metrics.description: Nominal value of treasury (bought-back) shares, from the equity section of the balance sheet ("Geri Alınmış Paylar (-)"). Tracked alongside paid_in_capital as a change-detector for the share-count ledger (katman 6): a change signals a buyback event requiring a new share-count-ledger record and, per company disclosure, a matching "Payların Geri Alınmasına İlişkin Bildirim" KAP notification.
